settings.editor: Join a team that’s building some of Western Canada’s most complex industrial facilities. At Glacier West, you’ll find opportunities to grow your career while working alongside experienced professionals who value quality, teamwork, and accountability.

settings.title: At Glacier West, you’ll be part of a team that takes pride in delivering specialized industrial facilities that make a real impact.

settings.editor: We value people who are dependable, collaborative, and committed to doing quality work.

settings._title: Careers What You Will Find inner

settings.title: A place to grow, build, and do work you’re proud of.

settings.editor: Four things our team can count on — on every project, in every role.
Work on cold storage, food processing, and industrial facilities across Western Canada.
Join experienced professionals who support one another and share their knowledge.
Build your skills while taking on new challenges and responsibilities.
We believe in doing the job right and delivering work we’re proud to stand behind.
Current opportunities are available in Alberta and British Columbia.
If you’re ready for your next opportunity, we’d love to hear from you. Complete the application form to apply.
